tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List Facade components and blocks (animated React + Tailwind sections for local business, real estate and agency sites). Filter by kind, category, tier or a text query. All filters are optional; without any filter every item is returned.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Get docs, install command, usage example and full source for one Facade item. Pro sources require a license key in the Authorization header.

tools.name: get_install_command
tools.description: Return the shadcn CLI command that installs one or more Facade items into the current project.

tools.name: suggest_page
tools.description: Suggest an ordered list of Facade blocks to build a complete page for a business type (e.g. 'plumber', 'real estate brokerage', 'dental clinic', 'marketing agency').

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_component" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Get docs, install command, usage example and full source for one Facade item. Pro sources require a license key in the Authorization header.
